title: Known Science and Physical Principles: Personalized Learning Civilization — Public Edition
description: Engineering record for Personalized Learning Civilization (Human Capability and Civilization Health). Sets out the established scientific foundation: what is known, what the governing principles are, and where settled science ends and open questions begin.
body:
This record sets out the established scientific foundation: what is known, what the governing principles are, and where settled science ends and open questions begin. It covers Personalized Learning Civilization — Adaptive educational systems that provide individualized instruction, simulations, and skills assessment.

Civilization health scales medicine from the patient to the population: preventive networks, epidemic early warning, resilient supply chains, adaptive learning, and universal translation as cognitive infrastructure. Demonstrated pieces — translation, surveillance networks, assistive robots — are real. The integrated vision (every person with a preventive twin, every outbreak caught early) is a systems and equity challenge more than a pure technology one. Honest records measure outcomes in disability-adjusted life years, not press releases.

Feasibility tier: EXPERIMENTALLY-SUPPORTED. Key components or narrow versions have been demonstrated in laboratories, prototypes, or limited deployments, but the full technology as described does not yet exist. Records at this tier separate what experiments have shown from what is extrapolated.

The established science behind Personalized Learning Civilization rests on Preventive and regenerative medicine plus assistive technology: measure risk early, intervene precisely, restore function, and support independence. At the experimentally-supported feasibility tier, the honest statement is this: the governing principles are understood in the laboratory, with open questions about how they behave at full scale and in integrated systems.

This is the public-edition record: it documents the publicly known research status of Personalized Learning Civilization as engineering reference. It claims nothing beyond the evidence, and every speculative element carries its feasibility tier openly — never presented as established fact.
